As someone who loves the Alien's and the Predator's universe, this game is awesome. It's a bit short but I am not sure if that's just my desire for more or if it really is too short? lol. The game play is top notch. Weapons are very cool, gun-play is well done. The Melee combat is cool but could use some refinement. The game really shines as you step up the difficulty. You really feel the pressure and that sense of OH CRAP!!!! LETS ROCK!!! like the first time as a kid that I watched Aliens! If the developers used this base game to make a more MMO style, large scale, world battles type of game it would be the only thing I played. 

As it sits, it's a really fun game that has some revisit value to collect all weps, skins, emotes, attachments, decals, and lvl up to higher ranks. Although... again, I wish for more story missions. 

THE COOLEST part for me is that it is directly tied into the book Aliens: Infiltrator. If you like reading or Audio books, check that book out before playing the game and it's really neat to see the connections.

Get some MARINES!!!
